The drawer remains extended. The gripper releases and lifts clear of its front, ending the completed drawer-opening manipulation. The gray bar remains untouched.
The arm starts a separate manipulation by moving rightward over the gray rectangular bar, lowering and closing its gripper around one end.
The gripper lifts and moves the gray bar toward the open drawer at a low height. The bar remains below the drawer rim rather than entering the drawer, while the drawer starts sliding inward.
The gray bar separates from the gripper and settles on the tabletop beside the cabinet, outside the drawer. The arm continues inward near the drawer front and the upper drawer retracts almost fully.
The upper drawer finishes closing as the arm withdraws. The gray bar remains on the mat beside the cabinet; no placement inside the drawer occurs.
